os-12-23.alt: A graph of membrane potential in millivolts against time. The trace sits flat at minus 70, climbs to a dashed threshold line at minus 55, then shoots straight up to a rounded peak at plus 30. Labels mark the upstroke as depolarization and the equally steep downstroke as repolarization. The trace falls past minus 70 into a shallow dip labeled hyperpolarization, then curves back up to rest at minus 70.

neuron-ap-refractory.alt: A graph of a neuron membrane potential in millivolts against time in milliseconds, from 0 to 6 ms, with six numbered phases. 1: rest at minus 70. 2: after a stimulus at 0.5 ms, depolarization to the threshold line at minus 55, reached at about 0.9 ms. 3: the rising phase, up to a peak of about plus 30 at 1.4 ms. 4: the falling phase, back to minus 70 by about 2.2 ms. 5: the afterhyperpolarization, a dip to about minus 80 near 2.8 ms. 6: return to rest at minus 70 by about 5 ms. A shaded band from about 0.9 to 2.1 ms marks the absolute refractory period, and a second band from about 2.1 to 4.8 ms marks the relative refractory period.
